description: Create document revisions from uploads with workflow conflict resolution support

403.description: The current user does not have the CAN_USER_SUBMIT permission for this project.

422.description: Validation errors detected (includes workflow conflicts, stale data, etc.)

uploads.description: Array of uploads to submit, with optional termination parameters for conflict resolution

upload_latest_event_id.description: This field is no longer validated. It is kept for backward compatibility and may be used for optimistic locking in the future.

termination_reason.description: Termination reason for existing workflows in the container (required if terminated_revision_status_id is provided)

terminated_revision_status_id.description: Status metadata value ID to set on terminated revisions (required if termination_reason is provided)

file_locked.description: Whether files should be locked after submission
